reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message to say I'd noted that Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is due 21 December.

I can't keep notes from one conversation to the next, so his message in the channel is the record. I looked for Thornbury files in the shared folders to check the date, but none came up. I offered to put a reminder on the calendar before the deadline if he wants one. Nothing else was needed.
